strings.en: I'll show you what my training's worth!
Like I'd ever lose to the likes of you!
I can handle a sword too!
I'll show you the Falken's power!
I'll make you feel/　the Falken's speed!
Even a melee-focused machine, I can handle!
I should be a good match for the Gunner!
I have no intention of entertaining you...!
Jua-Mu, I won't lose to you!
Jua-Mu, I don't have time to deal with you!
No openings at all on that one...!
A Raftclans... I need to be cautious!
That Raftclans... If I can turn this into a shootout!
I won't let you become emperor!
Iradoya!/　I won't let you have your way!
We're going to Rabulpaila, like it or not!
Try to understand how Fairy feels!
I'll stop you in Fairy's place!
What are you thinking, using something like that?!
To end this battle,/　we have to stop Herluga...!
Why is he dressed like a clown...?!
What are you planning to do/　by gathering only Kaana types...?!
If it's unmanned, I don't have to worry where I hit!
If it's a Zovorg machine,/　I won't hold back from the start!
Controlling Yokijin won't do you any good!
Skull Knight, I won't let you have your way!
Is the Dark Brain Army/　nothing but types like that...?!
XN-L... Whatever you are,/　you have no right to destroy us!
XN-L! I'll give you the same treatment/　as Dark Brain!
All of you, stop interfering with Earth's sphere!
No matter how many times you attack,/　we'll drive you back!
Come to the Earth Sphere all you want--/　you'll get the same result!
You get out of Earth's sphere too!
We have to stop them in their tracks!
I have to mind my distance with the Zeidram...!
Even a Zeranio-class, if I narrow down my target...!
I'd better watch out for the new model...!
Leave that White Horn to me!
Thorn... An opponent I can't let my guard down against!
Don't get in the way of our retreat!
That scythe... I can't just rush in carelessly!
I'll exterminate that monster, and fast!
We have to take out the unknown quickly!
If the unknown keeps rampaging in the city...!
I have to beat the Lamaris quickly!
I won't let the damage spread any further!
As long as we don't know its traits,/　I can't get close carelessly, but...!
I'll take down that Kaana type!
I have to stop the Lamaris Kaana...!
If those things multiply in numbers,/　we won't be able to handle them!
We can't leave the Ida type alone!
To think I'd have to fight that again...!
I have to get it off the Cross Gate, fast...!
I won't let the Yokijin do as they please!
You'll regret not finishing me off!
Where do you think you're going?!
I can't just sit back and do nothing!
Make me any angrier.../　and you'll regret it!!
Y-You're strong... I'll give you that!!
Kyaaah!/　I won't let you do any more!!
I can't die in a place like this/　and leave that girl behind!!
If I take another hit... I'll go down...?
L-Like I'd let you beat me!!
Ngh!/　The falcon's wings can still fly!!
Hold out a little longer, Gunner...!
I can't let you/　have the Cross Gate!
Even against a commander unit, I'll never give up...!
If I give it time, the other Lamaris will...!
You'll pay for that!/　Don't you forget it!
Hey, hey, hey!/　What was that!?
Aah! Right where the armor's thin!?
Oh no!/　Times like this call for Pattern G!
I-I can't stay/　a rookie forever!
Enjoy feeling smug while you still can!!
Ugh.../　It's keeping up with the Falken!?
Tch!/　It's as fast as the Falken!?
Unlike the Bilger,/　this thing's armor is thin!
And here I thought I knew/　the Zovorg machines' patterns...!
Ngh, I can't let the Fury push me back...!
I couldn't read the Thorn's movements...!
Geez! What is with that Yokijin!?
Al-Van... To think he could move like that!
Ugh, the Raftclans is/　pushing me around...!
S-So strong...! Every blow is so heavy!
If you think this'll keep going your way,/　you're dead wrong, Gu-Landon!
For Fairy's sake too, I can't lose!
Herluga, I'll stop you no matter what!
Ugh, having trouble with a Madnet...!
I was even able to fight Dark Brain...!
If I don't do something about that spear, next time...!
If the unknown gets me here, the city...!
I have to handle the Lamaris better...!
And I've fought the Ares Geist/　so many times...!
Ugh, it's stronger than Dark Brain...!
I-If I lose here, Earth will...!
Geez! I saw that coming, too!
I don't need you going easy on me!
Just come at me for real!
At this rate, I'm setting a terrible/　example for Arado...!
I should keep calm and handle this for once.
Geez! Why couldn't I dodge that!?
That's not enough/　to bring down the Falken!
Landing a hit on the Falken.../　Not bad.
And I knew how fast the Raftclans was!
I won't back down over this, Gu-Landon!
I can't afford to be held up here!
Showing off the Cross Gate's power/　like that...!
I misjudged the Zovorg machine's move...!
This won't make me flinch, Fury!
Those wings aren't just for show...!
Ugh, Yokijin are hard to read...!
No time to be grossed out!
Come on! Bring it on, all of you!
That's not gonna cut it, you know?
I won't be caught that easily!
Come back in a hundred years!
I may not look it, but I'm one of the Instructors!
I wasn't named after a falcon/　for nothing, you know!
This much is easy for the Falken!
With the Boxer's footwork, this is easy!
Did you think you could catch the Gunner?
I can see right through you, So-Des!
I can handle a Raftclans too!
Just listen to what Fairy has to say!
So you're set on stopping me, Reggiane!
Just dodging won't/　stop the Floraga...!
You can't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
I've studied how to fight that machine too!
Even against a Thorn, I'll dodge!
See? Even Gadisword machines are no problem!
I can't let something like that possess me!
Like I'd let a Lamaris catch me!
Even combined, they haven't gotten any faster.
Getting bigger doesn't make you a big deal!
Where are you looking? I'm over here!
No matter how amazing your attacks are,/　they're pointless if they don't hit!
Lieutenant Yon's data came in handy.
An attack like that won't reach me!
Oh no! I lost the enemy!?
Like I'd let things go your way!
Arado, we're going with Formation I!
Hey, Arado! Where are you going?!
I'll show you the Instructor/　Corps combination!
She and I really are in sync!
Got it, Lato! Leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Lamia, I'll back you up!
Princess Shine, leave the rest to me!
Radha, I'll follow up the attack!
I'll back you up, Major Kai!
Fiona, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Arieil, leave the rest to me!
Ing, leave the rest to me!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I can't just stand by and watch!
Arado!/　This is no time to look away!
Lato, get out of the way!
I won't let them get Lato!
Lieutenant Lamia, get out of there!
I won't let them get Akemi!
I'll take you down in one go!
Bad spot to be in, huh!
I'll finish this in one go!!
It may not look it, but it's pretty nimble!
I'll do even better than Arado!
I'm going to hit you no matter what!!
There's more than one way to use an Oxtongue!
Like I'd ever let myself miss!
B and E... back to back...!
Wings deployed! Drive at full power!
Seolla, match your timing to mine!
With this much output... I can do it!
Time to finish this! Gigante Unghia!!
With this many shots,/　it won't matter how many there are!
This is the end for all of you!!
Let's finish this in one go!
Odd weapon, but it packs a decent punch!
This Missile is a fast one!
If they send me the bill later.../　No time to worry about that now!
The Boxer is surprisingly agile, you know!
I'll finish this in one go!
I'll give it everything the Type Haken has!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
As the sexy one, you know~♪
These missiles are in a whole other league/　in accuracy and speed!
I'll hit you with every one!
It hurts just as much as it looks!
It should work just like the Falken!
